# Blueberry AI

> Blueberry AI's Smart Search enables intelligent, privacy-focused document discovery across cloud storage platforms like Google Drive and Dropbox.

Blueberry AI provides Smart Search, a cross-platform document search solution that indexes and surfaces files from multiple cloud storage providers. The product emphasizes privacy, multi-platform support, and seamless data integration for knowledge discovery.

- Document Search
